title: Beverly L NDE 22944
content: I was four years old. I fell and injured my head. I lost consciousness. Then, I was above myself, aware of the injured child. I connected to the injured me in a way I cannot explain. I was older yet aware of both of us. I could see from both views.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Life threatening event, but not clinical death. Critical Head Injury
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes It was like there were two of me. The older version helped the younger.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was unconscious but hyper alert
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning A calmness, brightness, more vivid color. Blue was very prominent
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I could see things in a way we can't
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe Yes, but it didn't feel like the younger self had the same knowledge.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Completely accurate, but happened at a later age
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The "older" me was very intent on me focusing on what I needed to do to be ok. And I felt in both senses of age an extreme importance
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will The "older" me was very intent on me focusing on what I needed to do to be ok. And I felt in both senses of age an extreme importance God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I never felt like a child of the correct age.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I never felt like a child of the correct age. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes That I was watching the then me as an older version
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes Many things but only shared two that eventually happened
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I wasn't scared...I was at an extreme level of peace
